# Alternative method: Manual factorial calculation using iteration
# Then sum digits using a different approach

# Calculate 25! using explicit loop (instead of math.factorial)
factorial_value = 1
for i in range(1, 26):
    factorial_value *= i

# Sum the digits using map and int conversion (alternative to list comprehension)
digit_sum = sum(map(int, str(factorial_value)))

print(f"ANSWER: {digit_sum}")
